reviews.text: Love Glo, don’t like most recent update. Love Glo, been using it consistently for 2 years now. What’s up with the new update though? I can no longer see my saved teachers or scheduled classes, which is a real bummer. Please bring those features back for easy navigation under My Practice.
8 years on this app. The UI gets worse and worse. Now I only see one class?!
Why. Why does Glo continue to move around the features of this app? The bells and whistles change so often it is distracting. Please please stop permanently tweaking and let us all breathe.

Offering less and less and less. Just opened the app today, and instead of many classes to choose from, it shows me one. ONE.First live classes are gone, now this?! How am I supposed to discover new classes?! Going to start looking for other options.

New interface. Hello! I love Glo! I’ve used it 90 precent of my mornings from January to today and the interface has changed a couple of times in the last few months and I’m ngl its making using the app harder than it is easier! I liked the way the way options for search were laid out before (clear, nice to look at, bubble categories) the list now is just more visually cluttered. I liked having more options to pick from when I opened the app, not just the one. I’m still going to use this app because I love it so much but I want to return to the old way the app worked 😭
Weights too!. I started for yoga, and stayed for barre and strength training. They have wonderful classes for various styles across the board.

Single recommendation screen is not usable. Long term paid subscriber here. The newly updated start page that gives me a single recommendation is not usable. I actively liked seeing what was new and trending as well as multiple recommendations. There did not appear to be a way to reconfigure my start screen the way it was. Happy to change the rating if my concerns are addressed.

Buggy but good content. i love this platform but within the past month I have no longer been able to add classes to my collections. When I tap “add to existing collection”, only 2 or 3 of my numerous collections appear as options, therefore I have not been able to organize my classes. Frustrating.

Wonderful. But why spinning?. I’m so thankful for Glo and its instructors! But, recently when I click on session, screen stays black and just spins. How can I fix this to access my favs?? Thank you, Glo!
Disappointed. Extremely difficult to cancel account and get a refund. Poor customer service.

Classes good, deceptive renewal practices. The app and yoga classes itself are very very good. HOWEVER. Beware that this company will not notify you of annual renewal (which is $245 as of this review) and that the website is incredibly deceptive - you can't actually cancel from the website, you have to reach out to support to get them to cancel your subscription. They do not give any straightforward way to cancel your subscription via app OR website. Look somewhere else if you want a business that doesn't engage in deceptive business practices.

Love this app, but kill the music. I use this app almost every morning and learned so much from my favorite yoga teachers. This morning there was a new update, which I added music to one of my favorite classes.Not sure if you’re doing that with all classes, but I’m not loving it. in fact, it interrupted my ability to stay present in my body. It’s distracting. And everyone has different musical tastes, so I think it’s better to let people choose to play their own music while doing yoga, if they want that. At the very least, could you make it possible for subscribers to silence the music without silencing the teacher. Peloton has a way of doing that on the volume controls. You can select more music or more instructor.Check it out and see if that’s possible. Glo is great already, no need to keep changing it up!

Review. Excellent platform! Love the variety of options: classes, durations, teachers, levels and styles. You decide what works! This flexible platform, covers all the bases, conveniently wherever you are mentally and physically. There’s no excuse not to take your the mat!

Expensive but decent. As a Jason Crandell delivery app, Glo works great. I also love the wide range of practices available. What I don’t love is all the little bugs and UI/UX issues that never seem to get addressed. It’s also frustrating that 75% of the time when I reach out to customer support, I never receive any response. This app costs a small fortune compared to others, but I don’t feel like it delivers an equivalent level of quality in the way it functions. Still, if you use it enough it will be cheaper than going to a studio.

Hot and cold. I have had issues for years with casting videos, certain clips don’t cast. I’m glad they are finally attempting to provide newer material (I have the app for 1 teacher) but what really sucks is the preview has now been removed so I can’t see glimpses of the class anymore. Is that why I updated it like multiple times in one week? Bring back the previews please.
Dark mode please!!!. Please have a dark mode for those of us photosensitive
A Partner for your Practice. Glo has been a longtime essential for my practice. I use it to supplement in-studio practice. Great breadth and depth of the catalog.

Ridiculously Expensive and Disappointing. I cannot believe how much the subscription price of this app costs for what you get. I’ve been a faithful FWFG subscriber for several years, and I thought I would try something different. Boy do I regret that choice. This brand of “yoga” is almost exclusively focused on the fitness part. The teachers offer very few prompts, and the classes offer little growth opportunity. I’ve used this app less than 10 times, and I subscribed back in January. I would honestly rather use YouTube than this app - even after paying for it. I tried requesting a refund back in January, just after the free trial, and I was refused. Never again. Save your money!
Marking my 11 year anniversary with Glo. I’ve been using this app on a daily basis for 11 years. Even before the pandemic this was my go to place for my favorite classes.

WTF guys - NOT a great start. I’ve literally just gotten the app, paid for a 30 day subscription and nothing is working right. I can’t finish the BEGINNING videos because it cuts me off less than 2 minutes into them and throws me onto the subscription page- repeatedly. I tried to contact someone rather than place this review here, but was unsuccessful at any other avenue. Can someone do something or should I just ask for a refund for an app that refuses to work? I’d prefer an app experience that is pleasant than get my $$ back. Someone PLEASE HELP.
PS. I’ve taken a screenshot of this review for backup purposes
Glow with Glo. This is the only app you’ll ever need! Great knowledgeable instructors, choose time, choose style, learn, and practice!
Glo is On-the Go!. Love Glo in my home gym. Love that I can take Glo with me when I’m on the road. Always a class to match my needs and moods. Have my go-to instructors and get to try new ones. :)

Yoga for everyone. I am so glad I found Glo. There is a wide range of yoga styles to suit your various needs on different days. They have live classes and videos. Also, series of classes with themes. It’s high quality instruction and video with an eclectic variety of teachers.

Happy member for many years. I love the teachers, the variety of classes and options here. My most frequented app. Glo Got me through shelter in place. I look forward to my morning sessions after dropping kids at school finally back in school). It’s the best way to start my day!
Lots of Options. So many amazing classes to take it all varieties and levels, with lots of great instructors.

The best yoga app. I’ve used this app since its beginning fruition. I know they’ve added a lot of fitness which is also great, but there are some amazing teachers on here. I love that I can do yoga at home with quality teachers and then I can also modify they’re always adding very knowledgeable teachers. Highly recommended.

What a fantastic class!. I practice with Jason regularly and really appreciate his style. This class was absolutely wonderful for building functional strength and mobility in the hips. As an avid hiker and backpacker, this work is gold.
Absolute SCAM. I paid over $30 for a month and yet I can’t watch more than a short preview with getting paywalled. don’t recommend.
Super Buggy App. Great content, incredibly buggy app. I have not been able to attend the live studio classes a few times which is super frustrating and one of the main reason I became a subscriber.

Do NOT subscribe to this app. Fraud- they will steal your money. Bought a monthly subscription and Apple charged me, haven’t been able to log in and use app. Multiple emails to customer support with no response. Horrid experience- download DownDog yoga app instead.
Yoga Everything. The app has everything you can think of on here

Couldn’t get assistance with apple based subscription. I signed up through the app with my apple ID and after the free trial I wasn’t sure if I wanted this membership, so I paused it and look at other options. I came back and was unable to use the promo code I was sent during that time to get a discounted membership. I was told that due to my apple sign up glo staff would not be able to assist me as the subscription shows active in the account. The only way I would be able to sign up is through apple full price. I was told to reach out to apple for further assistance but the link they provided did not have any options for this issue. The final email I received at this point closed my ticket due to me not responding in 24 hours during Christmas weekend. I have never had a business refuse to help me give them money before over such a small issue.

Life changing. I had always tried to do a little yoga every day on my own, but basically just the same thing every time and would get bored. This yoga app has changed my life having access to such a variety of classes with so many great instructors. I’ve been doing it every day consistently and noticed a huge difference. All these instructors are amazing. This is such a great app and so worth it
Rip off. These monsters will just keep charging you even if you try to cancel
Somatic yoga. I would like more somatic yoga classes like this please!

Content Excellent - App is buggy. For years now the App at times will not log a workout, within it or sync with your Apple Watch to sync to Apple Fitness. The developers at Glo appear to be unconcerned and unresponsive. It means that every time I mirror to my TV, the workout likely goes into the void. Annoying, and has stopped me from being a long-term subscriber. That being said, the content here cannot be beat by any other platform in terms of authentic, mindful yoga and mindfulness practice.

Glo has everything I was looking for…. levels from beginner to advanced,
a variety of teachers to choose from,
nice selection of genres

Happy to have finally found this!

My lifeline. Glo makes every day in this world a better place. I am grateful for the diversity of classes and for the best instructors on the planet. I cannot imagine life without Glo. I have been a member for over 10 years. The site is organized with you, the student in mind. The instructors are truly the best of the best in the world. i’ve gone on to get my 500 hour RYT with 2 outstanding OG Yogaglo teachers. Glo has been my lifeline every day in every way.
Love Glo. It has my favorite instructors, love the variety and class recommendations. I travel a lot for what is extremely convenient. I highly recommend this app
LOVE IT…. Wait a minute! Is this compatible with Apple Vision Pro because if it is? I'm going to be so excited!!!

Makes consistency easy. I have been using Glo for close to five years and I love how easy it is to find the perfect class any day any time. New classes are constantly being added and I rarely take a class twice. Has done wonders for my balance and strength, and completely eliminated my vertigo. Too many favorite instructors. I never see myself giving up this app. Thank you Glo!

Rehab!. This class is getting my angry, out of alignment hip to calm down, lengthen and primed to rebuild the strength I’ve lost during injury. I can actually hear my bones realigning a perfect prescription!

Using for years. Been using the app for years with NO technical issues at all, ever! Glo has become my yoga home and they deliver amazing, well thought out classes. There are truly classes for everyone, not just yogis.

Best yoga & fitness app!. I’ve had this app since 2015 and it is a significant player in having a daily practice. There are thousands of options (style, length, level, body parts, mood, etc) and the search options make it easy. I highly recommend this app for all students, beginner, seasoned, teachers, and in between.
have not been able to log in and no customer service. i have only been able to use this app three times in four months it never works
Thank you ❤️. Really enjoyed the class. I love doing strap variations like it is an in-home instructor/help person. Thanks again. ☺️

App stuck after latest update. Stuck on the refer a friend page

I cannot even get into the app to use it much less refer people

Been using for 5 years. Please improve this app! I love doing yoga on here but lately I can’t even make it through a class without the app crashing. I’m paying a lot of money per month for this app to not work properly. There’s continual updates and yet things seem to be getting worse with each update. 
Update: App continues to keeps crashing during class. Not worth the price
Great cardio and sweat routine. This was amazing and at my current condition, the perfect length. Got my heart rate up which is just the kind of exercise I need to incorporate with my yoga practice.

Glo yoga. Glo is the best not nonsense app you can have . It’s your yoga practice in your pocket ! Always with you. Sensational teachers and so many options . No gimmicks no promises of weight loss or whatever - just healthy amazing practice .

Never worked. I signed up and tried to access on my iPad it ‘transferred’ my membership to the iPad but wouldn’t work with my watch. So then I went back to my phone and it said it had to ‘transfer’ my membership to use on my phone. I hit ‘Yes’ and then nothing. I tried for weeks and updates and nothing. I wrote to them right away when it first was having issues and guess what…nothing. So I paid $30 for nothing. I suppose zen has no ending and no beginning so maybe this was what they were trying to teach me that I can pay and have no ending or beginning because there was nothing. Such a disappointment.

Search function is buggy. I like the routines, but I continue to have trouble with the filters in the search function. The search results don't update and change when I change the filters and search terms. The other day, I searched "run" for an after run recovery, and only 3 routines came up, and none of them were related to running. I know there are many run recovery routines on the app - why won't you show me them? My app appears to be updated.
Great app. Excellent instructors and tons of classes of various length and application

Inflexible customer service, horrible refund policy. I recently realized that I was still signed up for Glo when I saw a charge for the annual membership renewal ($245). I no longer use the service, and was hoping to cancel the annual membership a week after the renewal. Glo was unwilling to offer even a partial refund or to work with me at all. Very frustrating.
Best. Been a member for 10+ yrs Love it!
I love Glo. Use it everyday. And when I miss a day, I’m bummed.

App and website are extremely glitchy and customer service is unresponsive. I did a free trial and it expired and when I went to purchase the full membership is would not take any of my cards. I contacted customer service and the responses were unhelpful. They eventually stopped responding. I tried to cancel my account and the website won’t let me. It just keeps going back to the Home Screen and my account is still there. I created a second account to hopefully get the payment to go through and it did. But then when it was glitching out so much I decided to cancel that free trial and it won’t let me. How do I cancel my account so I don’t get charged if your app and website are broken!!!? rediculous

Koya Rocks!. I have been practicing yoga for over 20 years and I continuously come back to Koya Webb with her gentle yet challenging classes that push my boundaries and honor my intentions for my Yoga practice.💗🙏🏽

Classes are good, the app could be better. Features that aren’t there that’d make the app more usable:
1. Planning classes for a week / month. Glo has a built-in calendar to show your completed classes, but if you want to plan workouts your only option is to add them to your phone calendar. I don’t want them scheduled with time, I just want to play workouts for a week ahead. 
2. Programs aren’t automatically planned, you have to go to the program manually every day to figure out what you’re doing today. 
3. Your favorite teachers aren’t accounted for in class search. Why can’t you show me recommended classes based on fav instructor/ similarities to completed ones, instead of generic search? Given there are thousands of classes, this is pretty annoying. Home page recommendations “for you” are irrelevant- eg only recommends hatha and vinyasa while I’ve only ever done functional, Pilates and kundalini workouts on the app. 

Overall recommend for the quality of classes but pls keep improving the app.

Charged Again. They charged me again after saying they would issue a refund, because I had dropped the dispute in reaction to that promise. Very sneaky and untrustworthy, doesn’t care about maintaining a good reputation or servicing their customers without stealing from them. Reinitiating the dispute.
10+ year subscriber. The best teachers!

Bad customer service. I used an offer I was sent for a yearly membership. At no point did I sign up to be automatically renewed for this. I got spammed so much by glow that the email started to go to my spam folder. Then, while I am transitioning job out of town for my first job in this new role, I was charged for a yearly subscription. This amount was way more original amount I paid and it was something that I never consented to. I then came home, found the email in my spam that they had said that they had sent me to. It didn’t ask me if I wanted it renewed, it just told me that it would. I find this unacceptable. And let their customer service have the opportunity to make this right with me. While I do not want the service right now., I do recommend it often to my clients. Moving forward, I will not be recommending a platform that takes money that people don’t have when they don’t consent to it. Then, when given the opportunity to make it right, they do not take it. They would rather lose a client, then refund the money so that my life can be easier and I can still pay my rent coming up.

Great tool for yoga practice. I’ve been using this app for over 6 years, and it continues to be a great tool for personal growth. I’m always looking to challenge myself, and the variety of meditations and yoga classes keeps me engaged. There are a few meditations I find myself returning to often they’re that good. The app offers yoga for all levels, and the short class options are perfect for a busy schedule. Highly recommend!
Feel Wonderful. I only had a short amount of time and this worked out perfect… Thank you

Glo is my sanctuary 🩵. Glo has been such a powerful support system for me it’s truly more than just a yoga app. Whether I need a calming meditation, an energizing flow, or just a moment to reconnect with myself, Glo always delivers with intention and heart. The teachers are all lovely, the classes feel incredibly personal, and the variety is unmatched yoga, Pilates, meditation, breathwork… it’s all here.
I’ve felt stronger, calmer, and more centered since making Glo part of my daily life. It’s helped me through tough days and made the good ones even better. I genuinely want everyone I care about to try it that’s how much it’s meant to me. Glo makes self-care feel effortless and inspiring. 💫🧘‍♀️
Download it. You’ll thank yourself and maybe even me later 😉

Recent April 2025 update. I use this app to follow three two teachers specifically. I really enjoy their instruction and it helps me maintain my regular home practice. This recent update has made it so that when I visit these teacher’s pages and scroll to their classes, I am no longer able to see classes listed most recent to older. I liked being able to see these teacher’s most recent classes because as they learn more and teach more, their classes build on each other and often have thematic concepts occurring that I otherwise lose if I am seeing them jumbled up in time, some from way back and some from the middle and so on. I can tell because their spaces and locations have evolved or changed over time as well. I’d really like to be able to go back to how it was previously organized. I like seeing most recent classes.

Where did all the teachers go?. I just updated the app and the new filters are AWFUL when searching for classes. Over half of the teachers are gone and the filters don’t even match the selection. I wish I could remove the update. How long until they fix everything they just messed up? UGH. I can’t find my favorite classes any more. This is the second time that a major update is also a major downgrade. Why do they do this?

Update??. I just logged into my app and it had an update. I selected less than 15 minute workout to sneak a quickie in. Every recommended video was 30-45 minutes. It used to at least throw in a few of the time I requested. Not a single 15-20 video showed up.

Don’t outthink me!. All I want to do is search and browse for classes I might like. I don’t want an app to tell me what I will like and not let me look for myself. If the new app has a search or browse feature it is extremely well hidden. It seems to be a vehicle for selling me coaching services, echo I definitely don’t want.

Beware!. This company misrepresents their cancellation policy. I signed up for their free introductory package and then due to an out of country trip did not see the notification that my trial had ended. They billed me for one year of service and when I contacted them to change to monthly they refused. When you sign up there is language that states “ you may cancel at any time” but they will not issue you a refund. I was told it was clearly stated in there disclosure form and it is - item number 25 near the bottom of a long document. What purpose do they have of attempting to retain payment? Any company that is this determined to retain customers in this way is not ethical.

Not that great and poor customer service. I purchased an annual subscription of the app thinking I would love it but I just didn’t. I never used it and could have swore I canceled the subscription before deleting the app from my phone. I didn’t even use the app for a full hour in total. 

Fast forward a year later and I was charged for another year. I reached out to customer service asking them to please cancel my subscription because I never used it, thought I had cancelled, and couldn’t find any place on the app the cancel the subscription.

They wrote back saying that they don’t offer refunds and that you have to log into the website to cancel, you can’t do it on the app. So I paid almost $500 to use this app for less than an hour. 

HIGHLY disappointed.
Unusable broken login page. Impossible to use because the login page has serious problems, the layout jumps around when you tap the field to enter your login information and the keyboard never opens

Perfect yoga app. I’ve been a subscriber to YogaGlo for over 10 years. I’m constantly seeking new exercise options and I find myself time and time again coming here. High quality instructors, excellent variety and options for almost any kind of functional exercise you’re seeking. Just a high quality, world class app. I recommend it to anyone and everyone.

Exceptional Practice, extraordinary teacher, grateful practitioner!. I have been using, and practicing Glo, formally known as Yogaglo for quite some time.
Sometimes one falls into the possibility of greater advancement! 
I happened across Kia Millers Kundalini 40 day Practice and being a person of discipline I jumped right in. Pretty darn pleased. It was fun challenging, and rewarding.
Well, enough said. I’m still on the mat with Kia a good solid 3 years, but who’s counting Glo keeps me in a loop and Kia keeps me drawn to the mat, it is a great way to live!

Glo makes it all available, many choices, but I’ve found my seat, it feels like Throne every single practice.

Thank you all from the Sierra’s!

Jo Whitford

Sat Nam 🪷
Love, love, love you Kia Miller
Thoughtful presentation of ways to practice. I have been using Glo for about a decade and love the teachers as well as the app’s functionality.
Can’t cast to tv. Really wanted to love this app. Unfortunately, I spend most of my time with spinning wheels and frozen casting on my tv.Total bummer.

Connected. I’d had a session or two of yoga over the years, but I started practicing regularly in 2018. I used to travel regularly due to my job, so when I discovered Glo, it started traveling with me. I am now 63 years old, I admire and follow many of the yogis at Glo. Only wish I had started sooner, but Glo keeps me connected to myself and my body. I just love it!!
Poor App. Most of the teachers are amazing. It’s the app that is frustrating and archaic - especially when you use the app for your television.

Not a good company. Customer service is located in another country and you can’t talk to anyone. They wouldn’t let me cancel my membership the same day it was coming out of my account. They told me I should have read the clearly stated form. Don’t deal with this company. They are not in it for their customers.
Focus. Meditation has helped me to stay present each day thank you for these classes

All time favorite. I keep returning to this practice, even after over a decade since it’s been released. Something profound happened here in the sequence, pacing, and theme that just keeps me growing into my center. It’s magic and healing!

Great content, poor customer service. I had high hopes for this app, as the content is fantastic, offering great classes and a variety of programs. However, my experience with their customer service has been deeply disappointing and frustrating. After years of being a loyal subscriber, I missed the automatic renewal date by just a few days and requested a refund for the expensive membership charge. Despite the fact that I hadn’t used any of the services since the renewal (and stopped using the app for months and months prior) and only realized the charge after a few days, they refused to issue a refund. 

As a long-time customer, their response felt dismissive and unhelpful. The fact that they couldn't show any flexibility in such a situation, especially when it was only a few days after renewal, was incredibly upsetting. For an app that charges a premium price, I expected better customer support and understanding. Unfortunately, this experience has left a sour taste in my mouth, and I can’t recommend this service when the company clearly doesn’t value its loyal users.

Finally! Exactly what I needed. This is what I’ve wanted for so long! I use the app for yoga and I am so happy to find dozens and dozens of sessions with a wide range of instructors who are excellent. The production quality is also very good. I appreciate that most I have done have little to no music. I’ve been able to stick with my practice for three months, four days a week and I feel so much better!

My preferred yoga/fitness app. I’ve been an on again off again user of Glo for almost a decade, the offs more my problem than theirs, as I’m always looking for the PERFECT solution to any problem (in this case, keeping up a regular home workout and yoga practice). However, there is no perfect yoga/workout app, but I think this one is as close as it gets. I like the variety of class styles and instructors, and I think they’re all pretty high quality, tho I tend to prefer instructors who give a lot of cues regarding safety/alignment and proper positioning, and who stick to basics rather than fancy or complicated yoga poses. I also love the strength and fusion classes. New updates with the “my practice” page will I think help me stay more accountable and consistent. 

Only buggy issue I can see having just restarted use is when you add a workout to your calendar, the text is dark gray on black, and almost impossible to see “Done” or “Cancel”.
Great class. Excellent class! More ladder flow please!

Glo rocks!. Glo has been my go-to for some years now. I still enjoy some other apps but Glo is “home”. It’s the instructors! Each is unique and extraordinary and provide such great cuing that my practice has advanced SO much (after abandoning my studio when COVID arrived). So grateful!

Beware of this site. They will not give you a refund, even if you are injured.. I have tried to use this site. I am an older person, and I have struggled to find practices on this site that I can do safely. I got injured after doing just two practices, very short, slow practices, including one that is for aging parents. Two days and only two practices into the subscription, they will not refund me.
Can’t sign in. The forgot password button doesn’t work and I can’t sign in anymore.
Years of Glo. My mom and I have had a Glo account for many years. We love it. Filled with great teachers and a variety of classes. Grateful for Glo

Some great teachers, buggy app. Like another reviewer from about 5 years ago, I really appreciate the depth of Jason Crandell’s knowledge, especially the quality of his teaching, and his sharing of the evolution of his practice. But the iOS app and AppleTV apps aren’t perfect to say the least. After just finishing a class on the AppleTV app, I tried to use the “gratitude” button to signal appreciation to the instructor, but the app raised an error message saying that I needed to watch at least 5 minutes of the class before clicking “gratitude”. So I tried opening the app on my iPhone, and going to my class history. There was the class I had just finished, so I tried leaving “gratitude” there no dice same error message about needing to watch at least 5 minutes of the class. Which, again, is unbelievable since I’d just finished the class and there it was in my class history. The reason for such a low star rating for the app, though, is that clicking on both the “Support” and “Contact Us” menu items in the iOS app resulted in a completely blank screen with the only option being to return to the app menu. Other menu items in the same submenu (such as “Legal Terms”) did display the intended text, though. No way to contact the app developers or get support in the app? Definitely reason for a negative review (for the app and company, not for the quality of the instructors).
Impossible to unsubscribe. Negative option rule applies! Can’t unsubscribe!

YogaGlo. Excellent selection of yoga teachers. Easily filtered to find the focus you want. I especially enjoy the videos with Jason Crandall, Kia Miller and Tiffany Cruikshank. My current favorite video is shoulder rejuvenation with Tiffany.

I love Glo!. Glo is amazing! I have a yoga studio membership and I will not renew it and just stick to Glo. I’m so glad I found this app. I’ve been enjoying the lectures, yoga classes, mindfulness. I’ve tried yoga international and alo moves but Glo is different. It has more variety, more yoga classes that I like. I find myself finishing all the classes I start vs in alo and YI where I found myself changing mid-classes and can’t find classes that I like. The lectures by Annie Carpenter are gold. I like a lot of the yoga teachers already and I haven’t even tried all of them yet! I am very excited about this and how I can use it at home, when I go camping/ on vacation.

Thank you so much for creating this app and offering so much! I will be a long-term member for sure! And thank you for the 2 month free trial. It’s been amazing experience!

App not working. I downloaded the app and tried to signup with Apple. I kept getting error messages that say, “Sorry! Please try again.” I tried multiple times and was finally able to signup for the seven day trial but the app didn’t recognize that I have the trial membership. I can only preview classes and not actually take a class. Needless to say, I am canceling the subscription.
Following Felicia Tomasko. Master teacher, following her for 11 years for my daily practice, keeping me supple and ready for what the day brings.
Glo is a great go-to!. Glo has numerous teachers with a variety of I javestI h been supremely happy with Glo for 5 years. Affordable, convenient, and high quality.

Glitchy and poor customer service. Classes don’t sync to in-app calendar, programs don’t register progress, and customer service is utterly useless. I only keep it because my favorite teacher is partnered with this brand, but overall it’s pretty terrible to use.

WORST customer service…USER BEWARE. I have been using Glo since 2017, and while their content is decent, the company itself is terrible. I canceled my annual subscription the day before it was set to expire but they claimed I didn’t cancel correctly (I disconnected my account from Apple AND emailed customer service) but this wasn’t sufficient. Soooooo, they charged me for an annual membership ($245 😳) and refuse to refund me because the subscription is non-refundable. But here is the best part: when I log into my account my membership IS expired and I have no access to the content. I paid $245 for a subscription that I have no access to.
